correctness.rationale: Luce draw order equals the independent exponential race. Exchangeability within each fixed-rate block makes each conditional class labeling uniformly and mutually independently bijective, proving the exact mixed falling-factorial identity. Clock empirical laws and order-statistic quantile convergence give eligible proportions. The resulting uniformly bounded factorial moments converge jointly to independent Poisson parameters; the dominated generating-function expansion and countability prove total-variation convergence. Formula and derivative follow by substitution and implicit differentiation. The package script tests thousands of small exact cases but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact finite-step theorem settles a nontrivial natural case of a directly stated Luce/Tsetlin fixed-point conjecture, computes its limiting Poisson intensity, proves independence across classes, and gives a strict two-class bias phase distinction. It analyzes an important microscopic permutation statistic not controlled by the known global permuton theorem.
